To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) a neuro-fuzzy inference engine can be used to balance execution time of tasks in a multi-core system and b) this balancing can be done by assigning priority weights to the tasks based on their predicted workload, and c) this balancing results in a reduction of the overall execution time of the system by 11. 5%.
a neuro-fuzzy inference engine that predicts workload of concurrent tasks can reduce synchronization overhead and improve performance.

we have proposed a neuro-fuzzy inference based bandwidth regulation scheme to balance the execution time of concurrent tasks in the 51 IP object recogniton processor, and the results show that the proposed method reduces the synchronization overhead and execution time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of intelligent network on chip for balancing the execution times of multiple concurrent tasks in a many core processor.
the design of a multi-core processor that performs image recognition tasks in real-time.
developing a methodology to predict the execution time of tasks, and to regulate the bandwidth of the NoC accordingly.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intelligent NoC with Neuro-Fuzzy bandwidth regulation is a novel and efficient way of balancing the execution times of tasks in a multicore system.

the Intelligent NoC with neuro-fuzzy bandwidth regulation for a multi-core object recognition processor was able to reduce the synchronization overhead and improve the overall execution time of a multi-core system.
the Intelligent NoC with Neuro Fuzzy Bandwidth Regulation achieves a reduction in synchronization overhead and overall execution time for an object recognition processor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the proposed architecture is able to achieve the best of both worlds: it can handle a wide variety of input images, and can also achieve a significant performance improvement over the baseline architecture.
the Intelligent NoC with Neuro Fuzzy Inference Engine can dynamically regulate the bandwidth of the channels to achieve balanced execution times for the Feature Extraction Clusters.
a Neuro Fuzzy Inference Engine (NFIE) can be used as an intelligent bandwidth regulator to balance the execution time of concurrent tasks in multi core processor.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed intelligent NoC can achieve better performance by balancing the execution time of concurrent tasks, and that the neuro fuzzy inference block can predict the workload of each task in real time.
a NoC that can dynamically adapt to the workload of the cores can achieve better performance than a NoC that does not have the ability to adapt.
the Intelligent Inference block can be used for any NoC with packet switching arbitration to balance execution time of concurrent tasks.
